title: Kissed Roasted British Corn Tagine
description: A solo dinner dish featuring roasted dried white corn from Cornwall, infused with oil and cooked in a tagine pot, resulting in a crumbly and flavorful meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the dried white corn and soak it in water for 30 minutes.
Drain the corn and mix it with olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Transfer the corn mixture to a tagine pot and add the chopped parsley on top.
Cover the tagine pot with a lid and roast in the oven for 25 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue roasting for an additional 10 minutes, or until the corn is lightly browned.
Remove the tagine pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the kissed roasted British corn tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
